name: forgeline
description: Forgeline — governed AI delivery, on rails: PRD review → tech design → implementation → PR, orchestrating Claude Code and Codex CLIs through adversarial cross-review, deterministic gates, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Never auto-merges.
author: Angelo Zhang

scripts.hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo '✓ git hooks enabled (pre-commit: npm run ci; pre-push: refuses a direct push to main)'
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && tools/test-with-floor.sh npm run test:cov
